verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema alongside a Postman collection. A hands-on probe retrieved and parsed an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, unauthenticated, at /openapi/mesh-api.json, covering the customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources. The 404s at conventional paths only show the spec lives at a different URL, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: discoverability at standard well-known spec paths, and fuller first-party documentation of where the spec lives and how it is versioned.
